subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) Trump won the general election on November 8, 2016, in a surprise victory against Democratic opponent Hillary Clinton. (b) He was born on 14 June, 1946 is Queens, New York City. (c) He commenced his presidency on January 20, 2017. (d) Donald John Trump is the 45th and corrent President of the United States. (e) He earned an economics degree from the Wharton School. (f) During his real estate career, Trump built, renovated, and managed numerous office towers, hotels, casions, and golf courses. (g) Before entering politics, he was a businessman and television personality. (h) He then took charge of the Trump Organization, the real estate and construction firm founded by his paternal grandmother.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
